gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-asta-sans: Approachable and soft-edged, Asta Sans runs its tubelike lines under Comic Relief's bold, unfinished bowls. Next to each other, the heading feels loud and hand-bent while the plain sans stays friendly and quietly out of the way.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-bai-jamjuree: Comic Relief hits hard, with bowls left open on one side. Its real strength is the contrast with Bai Jamjuree, a sans so light and unpinched in its rounds that it lets the heading's bold swagger stand alone.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-barlow: Loud, loose and a bit cheeky. Comic Relief carries the weight, and its strongest quality is how neatly Barlow, a sans-serif with neon-tube strokes and c tips pulled far apart, steps in as the contemporary counterweight.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-biz-udgothic: BIZ UDGothic gives every bowl a wide channel, so its modern sans looks sharp beside Comic Relief's thick-only outline. Over a longer passage, it reads cleanly.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-bpmf-huninn: Chunky outlines meet a modern, single-weight outline feel here. Comic Relief is built to command attention with its unfinished bowls, while Bpmf Huninn, a sans-serif with wide channels into every bowl, is built to keep the words readable.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: Bpmf Zihi Kai Std keeps its counters connected to the outside and lets curves swell only a little, a mellow thick-thin touch. But Comic Relief earns its keep big and short, tracing one thick thread through each word.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-cairo: Cairo reads modern and businesslike, with a wide channel into every bowl. Its strongest quality is how Cairo sits beside Comic Relief, whose curves meet stems with no swelling and whose bold voice stays unmistakable.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-cairo-play: Cairo Play keeps its round letters open, so small sizes stay clear next to Comic Relief's wire-bent heading. Across a longer passage, Cairo Play feels modern and businesslike, giving the loud top line a steady partner below.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-cambay: Comic Relief draws a tube-like stroke of constant width. Over a longer passage, Cambay feels contemporary and modern, its rounds gapping like a cracked bangle beneath that bold heading.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-cantarell: Comic Relief commands the top with bowls left unfinished on one side. Over a longer passage, Cantarell reads approachably, its c tips pulled apart and its r, n and m arches matching their stems.
